executiveSummary: Multiple, concurrent threats elevate OT/ICS risk to Critical. Active campaigns target PLCs and OT management surfaces while edge and supply-chain exposures expand pivot paths into industrial environments. Immediate actions are required for water/wastewater utilities, energy operators, and any enterprise bridging IT and OT networks. Active exploitation of PLCs across U.S. critical infrastructure with alarm/logic manipulation and service disruption confirmed; remove direct internet exposure, harden access paths, and investigate IOCs immediately. Security Advisory Water and Wastewater Systems sector experiencing password changes and lockouts on exposed PLCs; disconnect PLCs from public internet and enforce gated remote access with MFA. Alert Confirmed destructive OT incident in Poland's energy sector leveraged a misconfigured private APN to pivot into control networks; audit APN configurations and enforce strict device isolation and ACLs before reconnecting. Supporting Report View Article FortiGate "FortiBleed" credential exposure enables AD credential theft and lateral movement from compromised edge; rotate credentials, enforce PBKDF2 hashes, and investigate for configuration exports. Security Advisory High-risk OT/adjacent vulnerabilities: unauthenticated RCE in Johnson Controls C-CURE/victor access control servers; multiple OPC UA (Eclipse Milo) flaws impacting authorization and availability across ICS deployments; EVSE/OCPP RCEs. CISA ICS Advisory CISA Weekly State actors: DPRK Lazarus exploited a Windows kernel zero-day (AFD.sys) in the wild with stealthy Graph/OneDrive C2; patch immediately and monitor for ETW blinding and DLL sideloading artifacts. View Article Multiple KEV additions across Aug 3-11 include N-able N-central (RMM), TeamCity (CI/CD), Cisco ASA/FTD, and others-prioritize remediation on any internet-exposed instances and verify for pre-patch compromise. items: DPRK Lazarus: In-the-wild exploitation of Windows AFD.sys (CVE-2026-68820) with Graph/OneDrive C2 and ETW blinding; target set includes defense/aerospace. View Article View Article
Russian operations: FSB Center 16 router targeting, and pro-Russia hacktivists abusing exposed VNC to manipulate HMIs. Security Advisory Security Advisory
LAUNDRY BEAR/Void Blizzard: Zimbra XSS zero-day campaign stealing mail, scratch codes, and creating IMAP footholds. Security Advisory
Head Mare APT: Supply-chain poisoning via TrueConf Server to deliver PhantomCore/PhantomGraph to participants; OneDrive-based C2. Supporting Report
Gunra RaaS: Fortinet edge exploitation leading to double extortion with large M365 exfiltration; FortiOS/FortiProxy auth bypass CVEs. Security Advisory View Article

descriptions: Exploitation of public-facing applications (T1190): Zimbra XSS, TeamCity RCE, Metabase SQLi, vCenter path traversal
Valid accounts / Credential Access (T1078/T1003): FortiGate hash reuse, LSASS dumping, AitM phishing
Command and Control over cloud/DNS (T1071/T1090/T1573): Microsoft Graph/OneDrive, Google Apps Script relays, DNS-controlled channel selection
Lateral movement (T1021), Remote services abuse (T1021.001/.004): RDP/SMB/SSH tunnels, VNC to HMIs
Defense evasion (T1562): ETW blinding, rootkit drivers, log deletion
ICS: Program download/stop, unauthorized setpoint changes, protocol misuse (Modbus TCP, S7comm, CIP/EtherNet/IP)

outlook72h: Disconnect any PLCs/HMIs found reachable from the internet; stand up monitored jump hosts for emergency access only. Enterprise-wide hunt for FortiGate config exports and credential reuse; rotate keys/tokens; validate PBKDF2 adoption. Apply emergency patch windows for TeamCity/N-central/ASA-FTD; restrict admin access to allowlisted management networks. Inventory OPC UA endpoints; disable weak policies; schedule upgrades; place behind strict allowlisting firewalls. For sites with carrier APNs: enforce device isolation, ACLs, and certificates; remove any APN-to-OT flat routes. Patch Windows August updates prioritizing AFD.sys; review EDR telemetry for LPE chains and ETW/driver tampering.
